desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.methodology: Median warm time per entry. Each runtime warms for at least 150 ms, calibrates a batch, then measures the recorded number of batches. Every timed return-value checksum is verified. Printed output is verified before timing; timed output uses a null sink (native) or byte callback (web). Formatting and runtime-specific I/O remain included. Includes the host call boundary and budget reset where required; excludes loading, process startup, downloads and offline compilation. Tiny examples emphasize call overhead. Shared machines and uncontrolled clocks; no universal target ranking.

methodology: Median whole-process wall time after one discarded warmup; shuffled execution order. C: cc -O2; Go: go build; ZX: portable VM (--vm); WebAssembly: Node, including engine startup, compilation and instantiation. Emission includes loading, checking, linking and writing output; it excludes downstream C/Go builds. Output size is emitted files, including C headers, rather than linked executables. Shared host, warm filesystem caches, no CPU isolation. Small examples emphasize startup; these are not language rankings.
